channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Residents Move Out Of Raided South Shore Building As Court-Ordered Deadline Arrived Friday
item.description: Some residents said they were moving in with loved ones, while others prepared for a night on the streets ahead of the weekend cold snap. City officials were on hand to arrange temporary housing through Catholic Charities.

item.title: Tenants Of Crumbling Uptown SRO Building Forced To Leave: ‘People Have Nowhere To Go’
item.description: The Northmere has failed all 13 of its building inspections since 2022. A judge ordered the building vacated due to the dangerous conditions, but housing organizers fear the loss of one of Uptown's last single-room occupancy buildings.

item.title: Chicago Sees Coldest Early Winter Day In 12 Years Sunday, But A Warmup Is In The Forecast
item.description: After experiencing the first subzero temperatures of the season Sunday, Chicago will see a return to milder weather later this week, with temperatures in the 40s expected Wednesday and Thursday.

item.title: Quimby’s Bookstore Launches In-House Print, Design Services For Zinemakers And Artists
item.description: The owners of the beloved Wicker Park shop have launched Quimby's Ink to help people self-publish zines, comics, art books and more. It's one of several new initiatives they've taken on in recent months.

item.title: 44 Affordable Apartments Planned For Rogers Park’s Sheridan Road
item.description: The building would include a corner storefront, which representatives from the development firm say they are reaching out to local nonprofits or small businesses to fill. Renderings show an outdoor playground in the rear of the complex.

item.title: After Chef Brutally Stabbed Outside His Home, Saucy Porka Owner Raising Money For His Recovery
item.description: An October attack outside his Southwest Side home left the restaurant's beloved "Chef M" hospitalized. He sold his car to cover medical costs and Saucy Porka just shuttered its Loop location in his absence.

item.title: Cinema Chatham Building, Once One Of The South Side’s Few Movie Theaters, Is Up For Auction
item.description: The starting bid is $350,000, according to a real estate listing. Neighbors and Ald. Ronnie Mosley hope a buyer fills the area's “big void” of arts and culture.

item.title: Cookie Swap Tradition Has Brought Women Together For 4 Decades On The Far South Side
item.description: Since about 1978 — no one remembers the exact year — as many as 20 women have gathered in Pat Duck’s Hegewisch home to exchange home-baked treats, stories and memories. The cookies are the "icing on top."

item.title: 4 New Bakeries Feature Tastes From Around The Globe, From French Classics To Inventive Asian Treats
item.description: Newcomers include Daeji Dough Co., Paola’s Delights and Abrah Bakery from a Ukrainian couple in Lincoln Park. In West Town, Frenchman Vincent Didry is aiming to open Guillotine Bakery by spring.

item.title: Portillo’s Coming To Michigan Avenue
item.description: The Chicago-based hot dog and Italian beef chain is planning a dine-in location in a new high-rise just south of the Chicago River, building permits show.
